meta.title: Build your map
meta.description: Two minutes to see what matters at your stage of pregnancy, who can help, and your next step. MILA’S, MAPS for parenthood.
meta.keywords: pregnancy, maternity, Bengaluru, St. Philomena’s, MILA’S, MAPS

intro: Two minutes. A few taps. At the end you get your map: what matters at your stage, who can help, and your next step.

text: Lovely. Roughly how far along are you? A guess is fine.
weeks.description: She walks from home onto the road.

text: Good place to start. Most of what shapes a first pregnancy is decided in the first few weeks, often before anyone has told the family.
Let’s see who is around you.
trying.description: She walks a little way along the road.

text: Congratulations. How old is your baby?
Do you have a doctor you see regularly?
doctor.description: A clinic appears beside the road with a pin above it.

text: Your doctor makes every medical decision. MILA’S helps with everything around it, from costs to what to ask at the next visit.
hospital.description: A hospital rises further down the road.

text: Good to know: a full delivery package at St. Philomena’s J Ward is ₹1,56,000 all in. Stay beyond the standard package is charged at room rates, shown before admission.
room.description: A price tag appears beside the hospital.

text: Most people are not sure about this one. If a room costs more than your policy’s room rent limit, the insurer can pay less on the rest of the bill too, not just the room.
Does your insurance cover the delivery?
insurance.description: A policy card appears on the road.

end.description: She reaches the end of the road and the needle settles.

ending.title: This is your map.
ending.consent: I’m happy for MILA’S to message me about my map. My answers are used only for this.
ending.button: Send me my map on WhatsApp
ending.after: Your map is on its way. Someone from the team will reply during working hours. A message is not a booking until the team confirms one with you.
